registeredBy: Sam (owner); no run made before this file was committed
hypothesis: When leveraged-fund positioning in a currency future becomes crowded (top or bottom 10% of the past three years), it comes back by 3 points of open interest within 8 weeks more often than after any week.
knownLimits: Only currencies with a CME future in the CFTC Traders in Financial Futures report.
Bands use only the weeks before each week (no hindsight), so the first year of each future is not tested.
An unwind is measured in positioning, not in the exchange rate: it says crowding eases, not that the currency moves.
Cases are treated as independent in the p-value; entries the same way in one future are at least 8 weeks apart.
